explanation: The discovery trace shows m_axis_tvalid mismatches at cycles 13-15, but these are likely symptoms of the invalid generate-block syntax in the original code. The generate block used non-standard Verilog conditional assignments without begin/end, which would cause synthesis/simulation failures or incorrect s_axis assembly, corrupting frame metadata and valid signaling. The bad-frame detection condition also had a logic error: it treated any masked-bit match as a bad frame instead of requiring all masked bits to match. Both defects are repaired. The generate block is rewritten with proper SystemVerilog generate syntax, and the bad-frame condition is corrected to exact masked equality. These are the only functional defects evident in the source; the trace mismatches should resolve with correct s_axis construction.
